source.title: Competitor knocked timer into lap
source.content:
Towards the end of a solve, when the competitor went to stop the timer, they bumped it with the puzzle and the timer fell into their lap before stopping the timer. The delegates awarded a *provisional* extra, but kept the original result. 

The decision was made to keep the original result (not use the provisional), as it was deemed that it was the competitor's fault for knocking over the timer.

translation.title: 选手将计时器碰落到腿上
translation.content:
还原接近结束时，选手准备停表，却用魔方撞到计时器，使其在停表前掉到腿上。代表给予了暂定的额外尝试，同时保留原成绩。

最终决定保留原成绩、不采用暂定额外尝试，因为碰落计时器被认定为选手自身过错。
